summary: The old Less branch incorrectly accepts 1.0.0-beta for >1.0.0-alpha, <1.0: both matches_exact and matches_greater return false for the patch-less upper bound, so their negated conjunction returns true. The fix uses matches_less, which rejects matching major/minor versions when the comparator omits its patch. Existing test_less_than in tests/test_version_req.rs explicitly rejects this case and the analogous <1 case. The proposed reversal restores only the Less branch. No tests were executed.
